Password blocklist v2

This small offline denylist was manually curated for Andaru on 2026-11-15 and extended on 2026-11-21 (v2: common 8 to 14 character patterns, when the minimum length became 8) from widely reused/common password patterns. It is not copied from or derived from breached credential dumps. Entries are embedded into the binary and checked locally; no password is sent to an external service. Update the versioned asset and this provenance record together when the denylist changes.
